scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
恭喜。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
We Knights have an
awesome responsibility...
To serve and protect.
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
我們騎士肩負著重大的責任...
為人效力，守護他人。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Even at the cost
of our own lives,
we must safeguard the
well being of our comrades.
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
即使犧牲自己的生命，也要守護戰友的安危。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Your time has come!
The world still needs you.
Please continue your life
as a hero with a new appearance.
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
屬於你的時刻到了！
世界依然需要你。
請以全新的姿態，繼續你的英雄之路。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Would you like
to become a Lord Knight?
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
你想成為騎士領主嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Congratulations!
As a Lord Knight,
I hope that you will be
at the forefront of battle,
and lead your allies to victory!
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
恭喜！
願你身為騎士領主，衝鋒在前，帶領盟友贏得勝利！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[騎士領主]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向戰士們致敬！
